youtube_description:
Jesus... I told him I forgave him. I meant it that day. 💔

She said the words, and she meant them. But the hurt still shows up every night like she never said them.

She: Jesus... I told him I forgave him. I meant it that day. 💔

She: But every night the memory plays again like I never said it.

Jesus: Saying it once opened the door. Walking through it nightly is how the wound closes.

She: So was my forgiveness fake? I still get angry when I remember.

Jesus: It wasn't fake. Forgiveness is a decision you keep making while the feeling catches up slowly.

She: How many times do I have to forgive the same thing?

Jesus: As many times as it returns. Not because he deserves it again, but because you deserve a heart that isn't carrying him everywhere.

She: I just want one morning where it doesn't come with me.

Jesus: Tonight hand it to Me once more. I never tire of holding what's too heavy for you.

Jesus: Healing isn't one moment. It's Me binding it tighter every night.

"He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds."
Psalms 147:3 (BSB)

Tonight hand it to Me once more. I never tire of holding what's too heavy for you.

Jesus's Replies — the questions you actually ask, answered from Scripture.

What are you still forgiving on repeat? 🙏
